name: iterm-profile-switch
title: iTerm Profile Switch
description: Switch the frontmost iTerm2 session to the profile that belongs to the screen its window is on.
author: dworznik

commands.name: switch-profile
commands.title: Switch iTerm Profile for Current Screen
commands.description: Switches the frontmost iTerm2 session to the profile that matches the screen its window is on.

preferences.name: screenNamePrefix
preferences.title: External Screen Name Prefix
preferences.description: Case-insensitive prefix of the external screen's name, e.g. the vendor name shown in System Settings › Displays.

preferences.name: externalProfile
preferences.title: External Screen Profile
preferences.description: iTerm2 profile to use when the window is on the matching external screen.

preferences.name: defaultProfile
preferences.title: Default Profile
preferences.description: iTerm2 profile to use on every other screen.
